query: Which distinct families of tests will we define for multiple-comparisons (ERP windows, time-resolved tests, CFA) and what hierarchical correction strategy will we apply?

response.query: Which distinct families of tests will we define for multiple-comparisons (ERP windows, time-resolved tests, CFA) and what hierarchical correction strategy will we apply?
response.answer: We define ERP windows, time-resolved tests, and CFA as distinct families of multiple-comparison tests. We apply the Bonferroni correction hierarchically to control family-wise error rates.
